blocks.text: The family of Gil Aducal Morales, popularly known by his stage name Ate Gay, opened the comedian’s wake to the public, before his burial on Tuesday, Nov. 10. The wake is being held from Nov. 4 to 10 at the Forest Lake in Biñan, Laguna, as per a statement shared on Morales’ Facebook page on Wednesday, Nov. 4. “We sincerely apologize for the late announcement. Over the past few days, our family has been attending to his remaining hospital bills and making the necessary funeral arrangements,” they said. “As much as we would have wanted to hold Ate Gay’s wake within […]...
